prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Rhodium (Rh) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a jeweller's bench with a loupe lamp, trays of cut stones and fine tools, a shop window behind
Time of day: dusk — blue hour, lights coming on.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a short white lab coat worn open over a cropped knit top and a pencil mini skirt; fabric weight — its knit or thin-fabric pieces (a top, an inner top or a knit dress) are 80-denier yarn, semi-sheer so her skin tone and body line show softly through, with a fully opaque lining over the bust and the hips; any tights or stockings are sheer 60-denier nylon; shorts, skirts, leather, denim and other heavy materials stay opaque; right now — strong light from behind passes through the thin outer fabric, so the outline of her figure shows as a soft silhouette inside it; the inner layer stays fully opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated sideways on a stool or bench, her torso turned toward the camera.
COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a second space shows beyond her through an opening — a door, an arch or a window.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
BOTH HANDS: both hands tie the lace of one shoe, that foot drawn up toward her.
GAZE: her eyes are lowered.
EXPRESSION: faint upward pull at the mouth corners, lips together, warmth reaching the lower eyelids.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — rhodium: a hard, brilliant silver-white metal that never tarnishes, found in 1804 in the residue of platinum ore after palladium had been drawn out, and named from the Greek for rose because its salts are rose-red; plated over white gold, mirrors and searchlight reflectors it gives the whitest, most lasting shine; one of the rarest precious metals, it has at times cost more than ten times as much as gold, the most expensive metal of all; most of it works unseen inside car catalytic converters, turning the nitrogen oxides of exhaust back into clean nitrogen — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: keep her exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.

generation.note: Original PNG preserved; only WebP committed.

acceptance: User selected 4,3,4 and approved commits and normal main publication; do not regenerate completed images.

observations: 1024x1536; one principal adult woman; painterly anime rendering.
Reference face, eye colour and skin tone recognizable; reference used for generation.
Visible arms and hands attach naturally; no obvious extra or detached limb.
Pose and shoelace action match; lab coat and shoes retain reference-like rose and mirror-metal ornament.
qa.cause: Output differs from recorded framing, hair or clothing constraints; preserved without regeneration.
